bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
test "$(realpath "$root")" = /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot || exit 70
docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:bugui-df701df >/dev/null || exit 71
old="$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs --format '{{.ID}}')"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$old" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 72
project="$(docker inspect --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' "$old")"
test -n "$project" && test "$project" != "<no value>" || exit 73
oldImage="$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' "$old")"
docker image inspect "$oldImage" >/dev/null || exit 74
docker tag "$oldImage" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:pre-bugui-20261119 || exit 75
test -r "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" || exit 76
(cd "$root/deploy" && docker compose -p "$project" -f gserver-compose.yaml config -q) || exit 77
docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:bugui-df701df gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
if ! docker compose -p "$project" -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs; then
 docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:pre-bugui-20261119 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
 docker compose -p "$project" -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs || true
 exit 78
fi
new="$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs --filter label=com.docker.compose.project="$project" --format '{{.ID}}')"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$new" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 79
for i in $(seq 1 30); do docker logs "$new" 2>&1 | grep -q 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY' && break; sleep 1; done
docker logs "$new" 2>&1 | grep -q 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY' || exit 80
db="$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project="$project" --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=postgres --format '{{.ID}}')"
test -n "$db" || exit 81
test "$(docker exec "$db" psql -U gace -d gaybbs -tA -c "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='gaybbs_bug_reports' AND column_name='prompt_message_id';")" = 1 || exit 82
echo GAYBBS_BUG_REPORT_UI_LIVE_PASS
